title: tests found implementation bugs
details:
- TC-CAT-1-06: expected 400 with Content-Type application/problem+json and body status 400, got 400 with Content-Type 'application/json; charset=utf-8'; body {"type":"https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc9110#section-15.5.1","title":"Bad Request","status":400,"detail":"Count must be between 1 and 12"} (TypedResults.BadRequest<ProblemDetails>(...) writes the ProblemDetails object with the plain JSON media type; the story requires a problem details body, which needs TypedResults.Problem / Results.Problem to be served as application/problem+json) at src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:250-255 (GetBrandMates)
- TC-CAT-1-07: expected 400 with Content-Type application/problem+json and body status 400, got same code path as count=0: 400 with application/json content type (same range check and same BadRequest<ProblemDetails> result as TC-CAT-1-06) at src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:250-255 (GetBrandMates)
